items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Burns and Allen are about the only ones I know that I met concerning anything, any rifts concerning the theater about billing and dressing rooms and all that stuff.

ctx.x: I was wondering what happened. We went to Oliver, that's what I was talking about. We passed that, now, went to Riverside, where I grew up in Riverside. Burns and Allen, where do you go from there, I thought was going to be another question. But it wasn't, I was just going to feel my way and I might as well go into Germany and start doing special shows then that way. If we can't go do chronological as we're going. And I'm trying to find out what to follow them with, what we talked about before, you said that you…
How old were you then, about this time, so I get the context
